n1.text: Home is a hub, not a tab bar: the dashboards already have their own bottom tabs, so a native tab bar would stack two bars. The bid in effect next gets the one navy hero; the provisional Bid 197 preview is a quieter row with an amber pill.

n2.text: Locked by default and again whenever the app goes to the background. One clear action: Face ID (falls back to the iPhone passcode).

n3.text: Two editable fields with the exact names asked for: Website address (pre-filled with https://www.blueandgoldfleet.com/crew/) and Password (hidden, eye to reveal). Save writes an AES-256-GCM sealed file; the key lives in the Keychain behind Face ID or the passcode.

n4.text: The bundled dashboard runs offline in a web view under a native bar with Home and a share button. It keeps its own stars, compare picks and name.
